prompt: Which rules can branch protection enforce on `main`? Choose all that apply.
explanation: Branch protection is the rulebook for a branch: required reviews, passing checks, restricted pushers, even read-only locks. Open issues never gate a merge — that is tracker territory, not branch policy.

options.text: Require pull request reviews before merging
Require status checks (like CI) to pass
Require every open issue to be closed before merging
Restrict who can push to the branch
